comment: Fourteen rows cover the callback-escape rules: a fort identity that leaves exact
storage makes its body foreign-called. Three rows cover the generated callers that
src/fort/ownership_source.ft merges into the foreign-called bodies of the graph. Four rows
cover residual and explicit call flow. Three rows hold the W charge of a mark and of the result scan, and the active operation of a refused cast scan.
A row names the line that holds the rule and the text that breaks it. The
module tests compile src/fort with the mutant. The table runs on a Darwin
host with --runner 'bash -c' after cmake --preset debug. ZERO_AR_DATE=1
makes the Darwin link reproducible, so the MD5 guard holds.
The MD5 guard reads the product compiler that the build links.
One 18-row run took 712 s, with a 2 s pause before each round.

stages.name: graph module tests
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/Darwin/debug/fort --std-dir build/Darwin/debug/std --timeout 900 -j 6 ownership_graph_test ownership_source_test ownership_source_foreign ownership_indirect_test

mutations.what: a fact outside exact storage does not make its fort identity foreign-called
a store through a pointer counts as exact storage
a local that an address names counts as exact storage
the site walk marks no addressed local
a global counts as exact storage
an indexed read drops the numbered field facts without a mark
a copy that keys an identity at an aggregate slot does not mark it
an aggregate built into a projected place keys its member without a mark
a cast to a type that is not a function type does not mark its operand
an argument of a residual fort target does not mark its identities
an extern argument does not mark its identities
a checked global initializer marks no function name
an initializer that names another global does not scan that global
a callback in the result of a foreign-called body is not marked
a body that generated code calls keeps the foreign-called flag of the graph alone
the runtime bodies that `new` and `del` lower to are not generated callers
a `main` outside the entry module is a generated caller
a foreign-called mark pays no W unit
the result scan visits each fact of a foreign-called body without a W unit
a refusal inside the cast scan lets the next cast replace the active operation
a residual call gets an edge to each body
a residual call makes its own body recursive
